general.description: API keys, media lookups, and sync history retention.
general.syncHistoryLimitDescription: Maximum number of sync history items to keep. Older items will be automatically removed. (10-10000)
general.tmdbAccessTokenDescription: Used to load posters from The Movie Database when media is no longer available on your server. You can also set TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN in the environment.
general.webhookApiKeyDescription: Used for media-server webhooks. Required before Plex or Jellyfin can send events.
general.webhookApiKeyCopied: Webhook API key copied to clipboard

settings.cannotRemoveOnlyServer: Cannot remove the only configured server. Configure Jellyfin first.
settings.jellyfinApiKeyDescription: API key is automatically generated during setup. You can manually update it here if needed.
settings.jellyfinApiKeyDescriptionNoKey: Login with your Jellyfin credentials above to automatically generate an API key, or enter one manually.
settings.removeServerAdminWarning: As an admin, you must have at least one server configured. If you remove Plex and only Plex is configured, you may lose access. Please ensure Jellyfin is configured first.
settings.plexServerDescription: Select the Plex server connection to use for importing users. Click 'Save' to apply your selection.
settings.plexAuthRequired: To configure a Plex server, first authenticate with your Plex account as the admin. This will link your account and let Scroblarr discover your servers.
settings.manualConnectionHelp: Use this if auto-discovered Plex connections are unreachable from your Docker network.
settings.noConnectionSelected: No connection selected for this server.
settings.removePlexServerMessage:
Are you sure you want to remove the Plex server configuration? This will:

• Clear the Plex server URL setting
• Prevent importing new users from Plex
• Prevent syncing for existing Plex users
• Keep existing users and their sync history

This action cannot be undone.

webhook.plexDescription: Copy this URL into Plex so completed watches sync to Scroblarr. Requires Plex Pass.
webhook.jellyfinDescription: Configure a Generic webhook destination in Jellyfin with these values.
webhook.embyDescription: Configure an Emby webhook under your Emby notification preferences (not server settings).

plexChecklist.pass: Plex Pass is required for Plex webhooks (or use Tautulli below)
plexChecklist.paste: Paste the URL in Plex → Settings → Webhooks → Add Webhook
plexChecklist.save: Save the Plex server above so Server.uuid matches webhooks

jellyfinChecklist.plugin: Install the Jellyfin Webhooks plugin and restart
jellyfinChecklist.events: Enable Playback Start/Stop and Movies/Episodes only
jellyfinChecklist.template: Paste the template (leave Send All Properties unchecked)
jellyfinChecklist.headers: Add Content-Type: application/json and X-API-Key headers

embyChecklist.url: Add a Webhook under Emby → your notification preferences
embyChecklist.users: Optional: Limit user events to the Emby accounts that should scrobble

webhook.title: Webhooks
webhook.apiKeyRequired: Set and save an API key under Settings → General first. Webhooks are rejected without it.
webhook.urlHint: If your media server cannot reach this host (Docker, reverse proxy), replace the origin with a URL it can access.
webhook.tautulliDescription: Use Tautulli notification agents if you don't have Plex Pass.

tautulliChecklist.agent: In Tautulli, add a Webhook notification agent (Settings → Notification Agents)
tautulliChecklist.trigger: Enable the Watched trigger (Playback Start/Stop optional)
tautulliChecklist.headers: Paste the JSON headers (includes X-API-Key) on the Data tab
tautulliChecklist.template: Paste the JSON data template into each enabled trigger

settings.embyServerDescription: Configure your Emby server connection for importing users and poster lookups.
settings.embyLoginRequired: Login with your Emby credentials to automatically generate an API key. If key creation fails, paste one from Emby Dashboard → Advanced → Security.
settings.embyApiKeyDescription: API key is automatically generated during setup when possible. You can paste one from Emby Dashboard → Advanced → Security if needed.
settings.embyApiKeyDescriptionNoKey: Login with your Emby credentials above to generate an API key, or paste one from Emby Dashboard → Advanced → Security.
settings.jellyfinServerDescription: Configure your Jellyfin server connection for importing users and poster lookups.
settings.jellyfinLoginRequired: Login with your Jellyfin credentials to automatically generate an API key.

settings.title: Sync Settings
settings.description: Mark media as rewatched when it was synced before or is already watched in Bingers. Rewatches increment the play count in Bingers (Watched x2, etc.).
settings.markMoviesAsRewatchedDescription: When enabled, movies already watched in Bingers (via Scroblarr sync, manual tracking, or import) will increment the play count on the next sync.
settings.markEpisodesAsRewatchedDescription: When enabled, episodes already watched in Bingers (via Scroblarr sync, manual tracking, or import) will increment the play count on the next sync.
